unit_debug.classification: Preliminary focused smoke before the final table16 and public fixture refinements. The current joinContracts function was reexecuted by the final 27-test Debug gate below.

contracts: Combined explicit RAW count plus serialized RAW-prefix presence uses checked addition before the count limit; maxInt plus a nonempty serialized prefix returns IntegerOverflow without traversing RAW descriptors.

Active detached word data and transform prefix_suffix, transforms, and params are protected. Word, transform, and dictionary counts exceeding their 64-slot arrays return CorruptFrame before traversal.

validateObserver runs before observation and compares chunk/protected tables, sources, the available actual joined scratch span, protected spans, RAW tables/data, serialized view/encoded/raw_prefix, and bounded nested backing.

A representable RAW descriptor-table span remains protected even for count16; entries are traversed only for a safe count. Unrepresentable invalid table extents are skipped by geometry so scalar join mapping remains authoritative.

Direct Into, PrefixInto, Append and chunk APIs reject destructive observer aliases before writing the observer. The aligned observer at scratch offset64 succeeds when the joined span is only 24 bytes.
No new heap allocation, snapshots, or quadratic source scans are introduced.
integration_and_fixture_corrections: Main added the initially missed profile validation to both pub noinline direct Into and PrefixInto observer boundaries; the direct source/output regressions retained InvalidBlockPlan expectations.
The direct Append output fixture reinitializes its observer and spare bytes after FixedBufferAllocator allocation, because safety-mode allocation poisons caller storage.

The unused-tail fixture now uses an aligned byte buffer and explicit observer offset64. Executed diagnostics showed the prior auto-layout struct had observer_offset=0, joined_len=24, scratch_len=72, so the production refusal was correct.
Main corrected the existing chunk_alias.joinedSpan fixture to capture its baseline after allocator poisoning.
observer_review.comprehensive_gates: Current Safe native/x86/WASI, decoder, and reference gates are owned by the main agent. This worker claims only the final Debug result above.

post_rebase.command: zig build -j2 test-br-decode test-br-decode-memory test-br-decode-memory-wasm check-wasm -Doptimize=ReleaseSafe --summary all
